title: Pink Halloween Entryway Decor
description: Style a pink Halloween entryway with plain hot-pink pumpkins, black bats, gauze and LED lights, plus optional extras from your own home.
intro: Hot-pink pumpkins, crisp black bats and a little LED glow give the entryway a playful Halloween welcome. Keep the console useful, layer in pink gauze and finish with a few things you already own.

items.note: Assorted sizes. The large pumpkins are plain and uncarved.

sections.heading: Give the pumpkins one corner
paragraphs: Start with a console, shelf or small table you already own. Group a few plain hot-pink pumpkins at one end, tallest at the back and smaller shapes in front. Leave a clear patch for keys; you do not need the whole pack on display.

Slide the pink gauze beneath the group and let it fall over one edge. The open weave keeps the surface visible. Tuck the jack-o-lantern strand around the pumpkins with its little black faces facing out, and keep fabric and wires clear of the doorway.

sections.heading: Add a little glow
paragraphs: Nestle a few pink LED tea lights into the gaps. Their white plastic flame tips give the candle-like detail without real flames.

If a second light strand frames your mirror, keep its battery pack secure and out of sight. Follow the product instructions for placement and use; check the actual sizes before planning your arrangement.

sections.heading: Let the bats lead your eye upward
paragraphs: Arrange a loose rising arc of bats above the console. Mix sizes, fold the wings for dimension and leave wider gaps as they travel upward. A handful creates movement without covering the whole wall.
Check that the adhesive suits your wall finish. Leave room around the mirror and keep the silhouettes away from door hardware.

sections.heading: Make the welcome your own
paragraphs: The porch view shows the entry from outside as Tommy Kate answers the door. Keep that threshold clear and use a bowl or basket you already own for wrapped treats.

The console, mirror, flowers, artwork, candy cauldron and clothing are styling extras, separate from the five listed finds. Borrow a vase or little dish from another room to give your version a collected feeling.
